name: My Favorite Color
description: A feature to remind you of your favorite color

model.description: Model the 'color' bin uses for its pass-cli-authenticated claude call (see src/pass-cli/install.sh).

effort.description: Effort level the 'color' bin uses for its pass-cli-authenticated claude call.

tag.description: restic snapshot tag the 'color' bin uses when it backs up ~/.claude.

session.description: Claude session id that 'color start' (the postStartCommand) continues on every container start, in acceptEdits mode. Empty does nothing.
